blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan on Thursday allowed former House Speaker Martin Romualdez to attend the pretrial of his plunder case through videoconference. Dennis Pulma, Third Division clerk of court, said: “The Sandiganbayan Third Division has GRANTED accused Ferdinand Martin G. Romualdez’s manifestation with motion that allows his pre-trial attendance thru videoconference, tomorrow, September 25, 2026, 8:30 a.m.” Romualdez has yet to file his bail petition for plunder, according to Pulma. He also said this matter may be tackled during Romualdez’s pretrial proceedings. Last week, Romualdez’s lawyer Rachel Ann Pomoy told the court they intended to file a petition for bail.
